children: Finland eye care solutions provider's Q2 net sales rose 48.1% yr/yr, driven by Visionix acquisition
Adjusted operating profit for Q2 fell 12.3% yr/yr, impacted by acquisition-related expenses
Company issued new financial guidance for 2026, projecting net sales of EUR 190-205 mln
Revenio sees 2026 exchange rate-adjusted net sales between EUR 190 mln and EUR 205 mln
Company says lower end of guidance assumes continued softness in market demand
Revenio notes ongoing geopolitical and economic uncertainty in its operating environment
VISIONIX ACQUISITION - Net sales growth in Q2 was primarily driven by the consolidation of Visionix from June
ACQUISITION-RELATED EXPENSES - Q2 operating profit was reduced by non-recurring expenses related to the Visionix acquisition
FLAT LEGACY SALES - Net sales in the old Revenio business were flat, with market conditions impacted by geopolitical and economic uncertainties, especially in the Middle East and Asia
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Revenio Group Oyj is €20.00, about 32.5% above its September 7 closing price of €15.10
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
